claim.notes: CFR+ (regret matching+, alternating updates, linear averaging), 50000 iterations, about 14 s. Exploitability and value were computed in exact rational arithmetic on the written strategy.json and reproduced by a separately written evaluator. Best-response values: player 0 gets -0.08560548 against player 1's strategy, player 1 gets +0.08560747 against player 0's strategy. Probabilities are 15-digit decimals summing to exactly 1 per information set; all 936 information sets are present.
